verdict.rationale: A probe confirms an llms.txt at zoho.com returning HTTP 200, so an agent can be pointed at it. However, the snippet shows a company-wide Zoho file ('a suite of online productivity and collaboration applications') with no visible CRM-specific developer content. Agent-oriented formats are absent: the docs .md variant returns 404 and no OpenAPI spec was found at any candidate path. Missing for 10: CRM-specific llms.txt or llms-full.txt content, markdown/agent-readable versions of the CRM developer docs, a machine-readable OpenAPI spec, and hands-on corroboration that agents can use the file effectively.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point an agent at llms.txt or agent-oriented docs
